title: Masking-profile operations, the PII record and the field-to-column map are not named for rwb-access
source: 04 User stories/Recovery Workbench Administration Stories v3.md (RWB-AD-004 Endpoints, Data and Guardrails); _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Technical Specifications by Module v5/Recovery Workbench TSD P4 Access and administration v3.md (T3.1, T5.1, T6.1); _work/msr/context/P4.md (ownership rows)
description: The legacy story asks for a masking profile per role and per personal field named as the view column the masked value comes from, masked by default, with an unmask that writes the read to the PII log. Three things have no value in any source. (1) The profile operations: the legacy Endpoints table lists only the two reference-load operations, the P4 ownership rows list GET /admin/access-log, GET /admin/roles, GET /me/session and POST /admin/break-glass-grants, and TSD P4 v3 carries no masking-profile operation id, so the read, the version write and the unmask have no path and no right except the Reference data letters of T6.1. (2) The PII log: TSD P4 v3 T5.1 INT-22 names the ACE logging path only, with no producer, record name or field list, and the PII log is not a table of rwb_access. (3) The field-to-column map: masking_rule carries field_id (DF-REF-200) and no view or column column, so the guardrail that a rule names a view column has no stored value. The P1 ACE-view read path the story consumes is also unnamed. The story fixes the three paths on the service base, declares the PII record content and resolves the field id through the P1 field registry, and records each choice as an assumption.
evidence: RWB-AD-004 Endpoints (POST /api/recovery/v1/admin/reference-loads, POST /api/recovery/v1/admin/reference-loads/{loadId}/approve) and Guardrails ('A masking rule names a view column, and no rule returns the clear identity number'); TSD P4 v3 T3.1 masking_rule fields DF-REF-198 to DF-REF-204; TSD P4 v3 T5.1 INT-22 (PII Kafka, audit and SOC logs, direction Out, approach ACE logging); context pack P4 'REST operations provided (4)' and 'Tables (5)'; TSD P4 v3 API list API-P4-004 to API-P4-021, no masking operation.
owner_role: Solution architect, P4 and ACE Common audit and PII owner
proposed: Confirm the three profile paths and their rights at the contract-group review of wave 4, name the PII record producer and field list with the ACE Common audit and PII owner, and fix the field-to-view-and-column resolution as a P1 field-registry call with no column added to masking_rule.

title: The published masking-profile document has no source line in the API specification and no ownership row
source: _work/msr/context/P4.md (ownership rows); _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Technical Specifications by Module v5/Recovery Workbench TSD P4 Access and administration v3.md (T3.1, T5.2, T6.1); 04 User stories/Recovery Workbench Administration Stories v3.md (RWB-AD-004)
description: The contract story publishes three masking-profile operations, six schemas, one fake and one drift job. No source declares them: the API specification and TSD P4 v3 hold no masking-profile operation, the ownership rows give the service four other operations, and the legacy story names no request or response shape, no schema name and no error code beyond the five message ids. The shapes, the schema names, the 409 for a version label already in force and the PII record fields are therefore the contract story's own declaration, held consistent with `masking_rule` (DF-REF-198 to DF-REF-204), the two lists of values and the rights of TSD P4 v3 T6.1. The consumed P1 ACE-view read has no path in any source either.
evidence: TSD P4 v3 T5.2 ('P4 publishes the list, reference data, rule package and workflow administration endpoints') names no masking endpoint; TSD P4 v3 API-P4-004 to API-P4-021 carry no masking operation; context pack P4 'REST operations provided (4)' and 'Events (0)'; RWB-AD-004 names no schema, no request body and no error code.
proposed: Adopt the document at version 1 as the service's published profile contract, add the three operations to the API specification index at the next revision, and add the masking-profile rows to the ownership map so the service's operation list is complete.
